result.summary: The interface is generally polished, with two minor visual issues noted regarding content display and imagery.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Implement a flexible text container or marquee effect for long titles.

issues.description: The use of generic vector illustrations instead of real food photography makes the app appear unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder graphics with high-quality, appetite-appealing food images.
